summary:
Completed implementation of Custom Cycle End-Time Override & Zero-Overhead Global Timezone Search:
1. Client-side native IANA timezone search engine (420+ world timezones including India/Asia/Kolkata, US, Europe, Middle East) with zero network bandwidth and zero Neon compute units.
2. Custom cycle end date and time override in Cycle Settings panel (e.g. 4th November 6:00 PM), with accurate timezone parsing and auto-locking exactly at the configured instant.
3. Strict multi-tenant isolation preserved across all messes.
4. Clean TypeScript compilation and dev server verified.
